name: matchcast
description: MatchCast - AI-powered live match streaming & commentary platform for authorised sports broadcasts

scripts.build: npm run build -w @matchcast/shared && npm run build -w @matchcast/backend && npm run build -w @matchcast/stream-worker && npm run build -w @matchcast/graphics-worker && npm run build -w @matchcast/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,stream,graphics,web -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:stream" "npm:dev:graphics" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @matchcast/backend && npm run typecheck -w @matchcast/stream-worker && npm run typecheck -w @matchcast/graphics-worker && npm run typecheck -w @matchcast/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @matchcast/backend && npm run test -w @matchcast/stream-worker && npm run test -w @matchcast/graphics-worker
